episodes.synopsis: Mysterious buttons appear in the worlds of Tanya the Evil, KonoSuba, Overlord, and Re:Zero. When the characters push them, they're taken to a place they'd never imagined...
episodes.title: Come Together! Quartet

episodes.synopsis: Now that everybody's settled in, it's time for the first day of school, which means everybody has to introduce themselves.
episodes.title: Tension! Introductions

episodes.synopsis: The students begin to wonder about why they are here, and what this school really is. Tanya, in particular, has a theory about Ains...
episodes.title: Deadlock! Classmates

episodes.synopsis: The students realize that they're all from other worlds, and begin to share their backgrounds. But some are luckier than others...
episodes.title: Encounter! Classmates

episodes.synopsis: It's time for the talent show, but none of the students are talented at all. The KonoSuba crowd in particular...
episodes.title: Explosion! Talent Show

episodes.synopsis: It's time to pick the class rep! But Aqua doesn't want Ains to do it, and Albedo doesn't want Aqua anywhere near the job.
episodes.title: Decision! Class Rep

episodes.synopsis: Emilia's the class rep now, but it's really hard. But she wants to do her best!
episodes.title: Carry Out! Class Rep

episodes.synopsis: It's time for a field trip to the beach, and the gang's getting ready. But who wants to see Kazuma in a swimsuit?
episodes.title: Prepare! Field Trip

episodes.synopsis: The field trip is here, and it's great! Everybody's at the beach and having a great time. But Tanya hears something that makes her upset...
episodes.title: Enjoy! Field Trip

episodes.synopsis: It's time for Field Day, and Roswaal hints that whoever wins will get to go home. But then they meet their opponents...
episodes.title: Join In! Rivals

episodes.synopsis: Field Day is here, and it's lots of fun for everyone. There's tug of war, scavenger hunts... and giant robots?!
episodes.title: Work Together! Field Day

episodes.synopsis: The mobile fortress "Destroyer" has joined the last game! It's up to the quartet to grab its headband and win the game.
episodes.title: Band Together! Quartet
